data.title: Cookie Settings Not Easily Discoverable
data.body:
Once you accept or decline cookies, the bar minimizes to below the Github logo and repository name in the footer on the bottom left. It appears to look like a design element of the footer, and it is not obvious that you should hover it it to expand it and click to launch.

I see it works the same way on eclipse.org, so it is by design. And the fix might not be here, but in the cookie module being used. However I thought I would call it out anyway.

data.title: Cookie Settings Not Easily Discoverable
data.body: cc/ @chrisguindon if this has ever been flagged before, and if you have any thoughts on it.

data.body:
@brianking We created a fix for this issue here:
https://github.com/EclipseFdn/solstice-assets/pull/194

I hope to deploy this on www.eclipse.org later today.

This is the code that we are using to display the banner whenever someone clicks on an element with the class .toolbar-manage-cookies.

The open-vsx website will need to implement something similar if they wish to hide the badge. The badge is our fallback solution if the manage cookie link is missing from the page as we need to make sure that people can opt-out or opt-in at any time.

Please let me know if you have any questions about this.
